# 实验需要返回：相对于确定性，记录恰在取过之处固定一个动作的结果；自己的动作若换一个会怎样，只在配置返回之处被固定；保留历史的运行永不返回，所以实验需要一个关于何者无关的模型 / Experiment needs return: relative to determinacy, the record fixes a move's outcome exactly where it was taken; what one's act would have done otherwise is fixed only where the configuration returns; a kept history never returns, so experiment needs a model of what is irrelevant

## 主张 Claim

设 r 是过程 P 的一个运行。相对于确定性，直到某步的记录把动作 a 在配置 s 的结果固定为 u，是指容许 r 在该步之前每一步的每个确定过程都把 a 在 s 送到 u（Run.Fixes）。运行在某步之前取过 a 于 s，记录就把它固定为运行所到之处（Run.fixes_of_takes）；P 确定、有两个不同的配置而运行没有取过 a 于 s 时，记录不固定它的任何结果，无论什么被识：把 a 在 s 改送到任一配置、其余不变的过程仍确定，并容许运行的每一步（retarget、retarget_determined、Run.stepsOf_retarget、Run.not_fixes_of_untaken）。所以在配置返回之处，另一个动作的结果被固定（Run.fixes_on_return）；配置永不返回的运行，在经过的每个配置只固定它所取的动作（Run.not_fixes_other_of_new）。保留其所经配置与动作之历史的过程（keepHistory，Law.withHistory 带动作的对应）中，历史每步长一，所以每步都是新的（keepHistory_length、keepHistory_new），确定性保持（keepHistory_determined），关于自己的动作除了所做的什么都不固定（keepHistory_fixes_nothing_else）。经投影 π 读：运行取过 a 于投影为 k 的配置，经投影的记录固定其结果（Run.fixesThrough_of_takes）；P 的步经 π 分解为确定过程 Q 时（FactorsThrough），所固定的结果就是投影为 k 的每个配置经 π 的结果，无论运行是否经过它（Run.generalizes）；有限多个投影配置之内，投影从每一步起都返回（Run.projection_returns，revisits_from 的实例）。Confound 中配置是一个隐藏位与一个结果，每步翻转隐藏位、把结果设为步前的隐藏位，动作不造成差别（Confound.move_idle）；只读结果时，直到第二步的记录固定左得假、右得真（Confound.misattributes）；动作与隐藏位同步时，“动作决定结果”的确定模型在每一步都容许投影各步（Confound.confounded）；在隐藏位与第一步不同之处再向左，没有确定过程容许直到第五步的投影各步（Confound.varied_refutes）。不用 Lean 公理。 / Let r be a run of a process P. Relative to determinacy, the record up to a step fixes the outcome of move a at configuration s to u when every determined process admitting each step of r before it sends a at s to u (Run.Fixes). Once the run has taken a at s, the record fixes it to where the run went (Run.fixes_of_takes); where P is determined, there are two different configurations and the run has not taken a at s, the record fixes no outcome of it, whatever registers: the process sending a at s to any configuration and otherwise as P is still determined and admits every step of the run (retarget, retarget_determined, Run.stepsOf_retarget, Run.not_fixes_of_untaken). So where the configuration returns, another move's outcome is fixed (Run.fixes_on_return), and a run whose configurations never return fixes, at each configuration it passes, no move other than the one it takes (Run.not_fixes_other_of_new). In the process keeping the history of configurations and moves passed through (keepHistory, the counterpart with moves of Law.withHistory) the past grows by one at each step, so every step is new (keepHistory_length, keepHistory_new), determinacy is kept (keepHistory_determined), and nothing about one's own acts but what one did is fixed (keepHistory_fixes_nothing_else). Read through a projection π: once the run has taken a at a configuration projecting to k, the record so read fixes its outcome (Run.fixesThrough_of_takes); where P's step factors through π into a determined process (FactorsThrough), the fixed outcome is the outcome, read through π, at every configuration projecting to k, passed by the run or not (Run.generalizes); within finitely many projected configurations the projection returns from every step on (Run.projection_returns, an instance of revisits_from). In Confound the configuration is a hidden bit and an outcome, each step flips the hidden bit and sets the outcome to the hidden bit before the step, and the move makes no difference (Confound.move_idle); read through the outcome, the record up to the second step fixes left to false and right to true (Confound.misattributes); with the moves in step with the hidden bit, the determined model in which the move decides the outcome admits the projected steps at every step (Confound.confounded); moving left again where the hidden bit differs from the first step, no determined process admits the projected steps up to the fifth (Confound.varied_refutes). No Lean axiom is used.

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 固定相对于确定性：比较的是容许记录的确定过程类（Joint.Determined），不是对展开的假设；“未取的不被固定”另要实际过程确定、有两个不同的配置。 / Fixing is relative to determinacy: the comparison is over the class of determined processes admitting the record (Joint.Determined), not an assumption about the unfolding; “an untaken move is not fixed” further needs the actual process determined and two different configurations.
- 投影是模型（FactorsThrough），由运行之外给出；有限多个投影配置是写在 projection_returns 中的条件。 / The projection is a model (FactorsThrough), supplied from outside the run; finitely many projected configurations is the condition written into projection_returns.
- 见证的结论：Confound 的过程与运行。 / For the witness: Confound's process and runs.
- 离散的步（从第 0 步计）；配置与动作是任意类型。 / Discrete steps, counted from step 0; configurations and moves of any type.

P49 留下的开放项（审查 F6）：一个动作造成什么，是有与无此动作的两段历史的比较。Ren 在 P49 落地后写“land and merge all, then continue”，看过结果后写“no extra review needed, merge, then continue”。读法（AI 的，待 Ren）：实验是在配置（按实验者的读法）返回之处变动自己的动作；重复是这一返回；对照是步骤经读法分解的模型；与略去者无关的变动是随机化的结构形式；以 P49 的识为读法，阈下与所及之外的不见是不分解的情形。见整合文档 §72。 / P49's open item (review F6): what an act does compares the history with it and the history without it. After P49 landed Ren wrote “land and merge all, then continue”, and on the result “no extra review needed, merge, then continue”. Readings (the AI's, pending Ren): an experiment is varying one's own act where the configuration, as the experimenter reads it, returns; replication is that return; a control is the model that the step factors through the reading; variation independent of what is left out is the structural form of randomization; with P49's registration as the reading, threshold and reach blindness are cases where the step does not factor. See §72 of the integration note.

形成变动其动作、保留或遗忘其历史、形成投影都不推出；实际展开经哪个投影分解是经验问题；随机或不确定的过程没有陈述；全配置的返回在实际中罕见，正面结果实际上都经投影；与 Becoming.Testing 的识的形式桥接没有陈述；动作与隐藏者的何种相关使模型永不被否证，一般形式没有陈述；读法是 AI 的，待 Ren；不含伦理谓词。 / That a formation varies its acts, keeps or forgets its history, or forms a projection is not derived; which projection the actual unfolding factors through is empirical; random or undetermined processes are not treated; whole configurations rarely return in practice, so the positive results in practice go through projections; the formal bridge to Becoming.Testing's registration is not stated; the general form of which correlation between moves and what is hidden leaves a model unrefuted is not stated; the readings are the AI's, pending Ren; contains no ethical predicate.

- 错误的投影误归因而永不被否证：Confound 中动作不造成差别，只读结果时记录固定左得假、右得真；动作与隐藏位同步时，“动作决定结果”的确定模型在每一步都被容许（Confound.misattributes、Confound.confounded）。只有与隐藏位错开的动作否证它（Confound.varied_refutes）。 / A wrong projection misattributes and is never refuted: in Confound the move makes no difference, yet read through the outcome the record fixes left to false and right to true, and with the moves in step with the hidden bit the determined model in which the move decides the outcome is admitted at every step (Confound.misattributes, Confound.confounded). Only moves varied against the hidden bit refute it (Confound.varied_refutes).
